viewers.description: List of file extension patterns and the command to use for viewing them. Format: list of maps with 'ext' (string) and 'cmd' (string). Matches the [VIEWER] section of ~/.ytree.

freeze_cmd.description: Command used to decompress freeze (.F) files. Default is 'melt' as per ytree documentation.

gzip_cmd.description: Command used to decompress gzip (.gz) or compress (.Z) files. Default is 'gunzip -c' as per ytree documentation.

other_compressor_cmd.description: Fallback command for other archive types not explicitly defined. Default is 'uncompress'.

esc_delay.description: Value for the ESCDELAY environment variable to prevent escape sequence problems on RS/6000 machines.
